verdict.rationale: The UCP spec Shopify builds on describes AP2 payment mandates that let agents "transact on behalf of users with pre-defined, verifiable boundaries." It also describes "cryptographically signed payment authorizations that are mathematically tied to the specific state of the cart," which implicitly scopes a payment to one cart, amount and merchant. However, this is protocol-level material on ucp.dev. Shopify's own checkout docs only mention collecting a "payment credential" and negotiated payment handlers such as com.google.pay. Missing for 10: Shopify-documented support for agent-held scoped credentials, explicit amount-limit, expiry and merchant-restriction parameters, and hands-on evidence of a mandate-based checkout completing.
